'''Berow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the apprentice of [[Darth Serevin]].<ref name="Mail" /> Residing on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in [[Mos Ila]], she asked an Imperial working for [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Vilos]] to destroy any [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] that proved to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="SHA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Berow first appeared in the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].

She is only accessible to Imperial players in the game on Tatooine.
